mechanisms.meaning: no valid entry basis (version or venue check failed) -- the row is NOT a measurement and must not enter a rate
measurement_version predates the current contract -- excluded by version
a basis exists but `covered(target)` is False -- carried as a LOWER BOUND, never as a zero
coverage satisfied -- the only status that supports a rate
a tape-priced REFUSAL is followable as a counterfactual, so it earns its own basis instead of being discarded as unverified
a token with no marks carries no rung evidence; `sizing.target_hit_rate` drops these rows explicitly
written 1 only when a rung was OBSERVED; a miss is left blank rather than 0 unless the horizon completed
withheld when the horizon is incomplete -- never a 0 that would read as 'traded flat'
'missing' == no NEW print; transport_ok separates a quiet pool (True) from a failed fetch (False)
NULL is an ABSENCE (reported, not an error); an exact 0.0 on a bag with a cost is a SILENT ZERO and IS an error, because COALESCE keeps it
a failed query yields no verdict at all -- neither pass nor failure
a severity outside (0, 1] is REFUSED rather than clipped, so an invalid loss cannot size a ticket
